title: Ruthless Survival
description: This modpack focuses on the beauty of Minecraft and the survival aspect of it. Still Life as the main tarrain generation mod makes it possible for mesmerizing areas to be generated. With the help of Distant Horizons you can see the vast beautiful lands.
body:
In this pack you survive the not so brutal heat/cold and with seasons it is harder to grow crops. But if you are a great builder _**you will surely love this pack as it brings about the most beutiful tarrain and spots to build at.**_ 
With _Distant Horizons_ you can unlock the true potential of the pack, seeing all that is around you. 
_Farmer's Delight_ adds so many new crops and food to make. _Serene Seasons_ adding amazing visuals for each seasons, also compatible with _Farmer's Delight_. **Makeing a greenhouse is a big part of the pack as the crops refuse to grow in certain seasons.** 
When the Winter comes it will be rough with _Tough as Nails_ adding thirst and tempature. The water near you starts to freeze a white hazing forms around you and you start to get chills. But in the end it is all worth it as the snow looks abselutly beutiful (with shaders its even better).
